crossRefs.note: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar…

translations.web: “Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’
translations.bsb: Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and reign over us.’
translations.kjv: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign
translations.asv: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
